title: Covered Category Lists for Ancillary and Optional Services Billing
content:
Ancillary and Optional Services Billing keeps the same coverage lists and coverage settings on every ancillary account tier, from Ancillary Account, Medicare Part A Consolidated Billing through Ancillary Account, Hospice Election. They are set out below as the reimbursement reference holds them.

## Ancillary categories Medicare Part B pays for a resident not in a Part A stay

- Lab
- Radiology
- Surgical dressings
- Prosthetics and orthotics
- Enteral and parenteral nutrition

## Items and services the Medicaid per diem includes

These are the items and services the Medicaid per diem includes and for which no Medicaid resident may be charged (42 CFR 483.10(f)(11)(i)):

- Routine personal hygiene
- Standard incontinence supplies
- Medical supplies
- Oxygen
- Routine laundry
- Standard diet
- Activities program

## Coverage settings

| Setting | Value in every tier |
|---|---|
| Durable medical equipment used in the center is billable to Medicare Part B | No (a nursing facility is not a home for the durable medical equipment benefit) |
| Prescription drugs outside a Part A stay are billed by the center | No (the contracted pharmacy bills them) |
| An item the resident's payer covers may be billed to the resident | No |

## Points of reference

- **Is oxygen on the Medicaid per diem list?** Yes; oxygen appears on the list of items and services the Medicaid per diem includes.
- **Is durable medical equipment used in the center billed to Part B?** No; in every tier, durable medical equipment used in the center is not billable to Part B.
- **Does a tier change any of these lists?** No; every tier carries the same two lists and the same three settings.
